arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ إِذَا السَّماءُ انفَطَرَت
translation: When the heaven is cleft asunder
When the seas are poured forth
A soul will know what it hath sent before (it) and what left behind

arabic: يٰأَيُّهَا الإِنسٰنُ ما غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ الكَريمِ
transliteration: Ya ayyuha alinsanu ma gharraka birabbika alkareemi
translation: O man! What hath made thee careless concerning thy Lord, the Bountiful
Who created thee, then fashioned, then proportioned thee

arabic: فى أَىِّ صورَةٍ ما شاءَ رَكَّبَكَ
transliteration: Fee ayyi sooratin ma shaa rakkabaka
translation: Into whatsoever form He will, He casteth thee
Nay, but ye deny the Judgment
Lo! there are above you guardians
Lo! the righteous verily will be in delight
And lo! the wicked verily will be in hell
They will burn therein on the Day of Judgment
And will not be absent thence
Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Day of Judgment is

arabic: ثُمَّ ما أَدرىٰكَ ما يَومُ الدّينِ
transliteration: Thumma ma adraka ma yawmu alddeeni
translation: Again, what will convey unto thee what the Day of Judgment is

arabic: يَومَ لا تَملِكُ نَفسٌ لِنَفسٍ شَيـًٔا وَالأَمرُ يَومَئِذٍ لِلَّهِ
transliteration: Yawma la tamliku nafsun linafsin shayan waalamru yawmaithin lillahi
translation: A day on which no soul hath power at all for any (other) soul. The (absolute) command on that day is Allah's
